In most spreadsheets you can sort a column alphabetically in just a few clicks:

**Google Sheets**
1. Select the cells (or the whole column) you want to sort.  
2. Click **Data → Sort range**.  
3. Choose “Data has header row” if applicable, then pick **A → Z** (ascending) or **Z → A** (descending).  
4. Click **Sort**.

**Microsoft Excel**
1. Click any cell in the column you want to sort.  
2. Go to the **Home** tab → **Sort & Filter**.  
3. Choose **Sort A to Z** (or **Z to A**).  
   - If your data has headers, Excel will ask whether to expand the selection; pick “Continue with the current selection” to sort only that column, or “Expand the selection” to keep rows together.

That’s it—your list will be alphabetized instantly.
